title: skills objectstack-ai SKILL.md: the 'resolution ladder' section names three lint sources for tool names; MCP_FILE_TOOL_NAMES (#35034) makes four
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (mailbox #32588, 6964402867, item 2), from #34948 / PR #35034.

`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, section "Naming the tools: the resolution ladder", says the lint resolves tool names from **three** sources. Once #35034 adds `MCP_FILE_TOOL_NAMES` there are **four**, so the text goes stale when #35034 lands.

Done when the section names the fourth source, and, if #35036 widens the set further, names it from the same pinned export, so the ladder cannot drift again.

Grade: **p2 · domain:skills**. Theme: MCP (skills that teach authoring); an agent following the ladder would miss the file tools. It is a governed `skills/**` text change.

Blocked-by: #35034
